00055: fun checkDownloadFileExists(context: Context, fileName: String): Boolean {
00056:     if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.Q) {
00057:         try {
00058:             val resolver = context.contentResolver
00059:             val projection = arrayOf(MediaStore.MediaColumns._ID)
00060:             val selection = "${MediaStore.MediaColumns.DISPLAY_NAME} = ? AND ${MediaStore.MediaColumns.RELATIVE_PATH} LIKE ?"
00061:             val selectionArgs = arrayOf(fileName, "%${Environment.DIRECTORY_DOWNLOADS}%")
00062:             resolver.query(MediaStore.Downloads.EXTERNAL_CONTENT_URI, projection, selection, selectionArgs, null)?.use { cursor ->
00063:                 if (cursor.count > 0) return true
00064:             }
00065:         } catch (_: Exception) {}
00066:     }
00067:     val publicDir = Environment.getExternalStoragePublicDirectory(Environment.DIRECTORY_DOWNLOADS)
00068:     if (File(publicDir, fileName).exists()) return true
00069:
00070:     val appDir = context.getExternalFilesDir(Environment.DIRECTORY_DOWNLOADS)
00071:     if (appDir != null && File(appDir, fileName).exists()) return true
00072:
00073:     return false
00074: }
00075:
00076: fun getSuggestedFileName(context: Context, originalFileName: String): String {
00077:     val dotIndex = originalFileName.lastIndexOf('.')
00078:     val baseName: String
00079:     val extension: String
00080:     if (dotIndex > 0) {
00081:         baseName = originalFileName.substring(0, dotIndex)
00082:         extension = originalFileName.substring(dotIndex)
00083:     } else {
00084:         baseName = originalFileName
00085:         extension = ""
00086:     }
00087:
00088:     val cleanBaseName = baseName.replace(Regex("""\s*\(\d+\)$"""), "")
00089:
00090:     var counter = 1
00091:     var candidate = "$cleanBaseName ($counter)$extension"
00092:     while (checkDownloadFileExists(context, candidate)) {
00093:         counter++
00094:         candidate = "$cleanBaseName ($counter)$extension"
00095:     }
00096:     return candidate
00097: }

00099: fun getSuggestedRemoteFileName(existingNames: List<String>, originalFileName: String): String {
00100:     val dotIndex = originalFileName.lastIndexOf('.')
00101:     val baseName: String
00102:     val extension: String
00103:     if (dotIndex > 0) {
00104:         baseName = originalFileName.substring(0, dotIndex)
00105:         extension = originalFileName.substring(dotIndex)
00106:     } else {
00107:         baseName = originalFileName
00108:         extension = ""
00109:     }
00110:
00111:     val cleanBaseName = baseName.replace(Regex("""\s*\(\d+\)$"""), "")
00112:
00113:     var counter = 1
00114:     var candidate = "$cleanBaseName ($counter)$extension"
00115:     while (existingNames.any { it.equals(candidate, ignoreCase = true) }) {
00116:         counter++
00117:         candidate = "$cleanBaseName ($counter)$extension"
00118:     }
00119:     return candidate
00120: }

00122: fun deleteLocalDownloadFileIfExists(context: Context, fileName: String) {
00123:     try {
00124:         if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.Q) {
00125:             val resolver = context.contentResolver
00126:             val selection = "${MediaStore.MediaColumns.DISPLAY_NAME} = ? AND ${MediaStore.MediaColumns.RELATIVE_PATH} LIKE ?"
00127:             val selectionArgs = arrayOf(fileName, "%${Environment.DIRECTORY_DOWNLOADS}%")
00128:             resolver.delete(MediaStore.Downloads.EXTERNAL_CONTENT_URI, selection, selectionArgs)
00129:         }
00130:         val publicDir = Environment.getExternalStoragePublicDirectory(Environment.DIRECTORY_DOWNLOADS)
00131:         val file1 = File(publicDir, fileName)
00132:         if (file1.exists()) file1.delete()
00133:
00134:         val appDir = context.getExternalFilesDir(Environment.DIRECTORY_DOWNLOADS)
00135:         if (appDir != null) {
00136:             val file2 = File(appDir, fileName)
00137:             if (file2.exists()) file2.delete()
00138:         }
00139:     } catch (e: Exception) {
00140:         Log.e("MeshFilesDownload", "Error deleting local download file $fileName: ${e.localizedMessage}")
00141:     }
00142: }

00265:     private fun isProtocolJsonMessage(text: String): Boolean {
00266:         val trimmed = text.trim()
00267:         if (!trimmed.startsWith("{") || !trimmed.endsWith("}")) return false
00268:         return try {
00269:             val json = gson.fromJson(trimmed, JsonObject::class.java) ?: return false
00270:             val action = json.get("action")?.asString ?: ""
00271:             if (action in setOf("downloadStart", "downloadEnd", "downloadError")) {
00272:                 return true
00273:             }
00274:             action in setOf("ls", "dir", "download", "read", "readfile", "msg", "upload", "mkdir", "rm", "deletefile", "deletefolder", "rmdir", "rmfile", "rename", "zip", "unzip", "dialogmessage") ||
00275:                     (json.has("path") && (json.has("dir") || json.has("files") || json.has("list")))
00276:         } catch (e: Exception) {
00277:             false
00278:         }
00279:     }

00281:     suspend fun ensureControlSocketConnected(): Boolean {
00282:         if (meshClient.connectionState.value) return true
00283:         Log.d("MeshFiles", "Control socket not connected, triggering immediate reconnect...")
00284:         meshClient.reconnectNow()
00285:         var waitMs = 0
00286:         while (!meshClient.connectionState.value && waitMs < 6000) {
00287:             delay(100)
00288:             waitMs += 100
00289:         }
00290:         return meshClient.connectionState.value
00291:     }
00292:
00293:     suspend fun ensureConnected(): Boolean {
00294:         ensureControlSocketConnected()
00295:         if (_connectionState.value && webSocket != null) return true
00296:
00297:         if (webSocket == null || !_connectionState.value || isUserDisconnect) {
00298:             Log.d("MeshFiles", "Auto-reconnecting file relay for node '$cleanNodeId'...")
00299:             connect()
00300:         }
00301:
00302:         var waitMs = 0
00303:         while (!_connectionState.value && waitMs < 8000) {
00304:             delay(100)
00305:             waitMs += 100
00306:         }
00307:         return _connectionState.value
00308:     }
00309:
00310:     fun connect() {
00311:         isUserDisconnect = false
00312:
00313:         if (isConnected()) {
00314:             Log.d("MeshFiles", "Already connected to node: $cleanNodeId. Reusing files session at path: ${_currentPath.value}")
00315:             listDirectory(_currentPath.value)
00316:             return
00317:         }
00318:
00319:         val serverUrl = meshClient.serverUrl
00320:         val cookie = meshClient.authCookie
00321:         val relayToken = meshClient.relayAuthCookie.ifEmpty {
